2.old: Albion is an MLS® sub-area name. The City of Maple Ridge doesn’t publish a boundary for it. The City’s neighbourhoods page groups the area as Albion/Kanaka.
2.new: The name Albion is an MLS® sub-area label, and the City of Maple Ridge has no published boundary for it. On the City’s neighbourhoods page, the area is grouped as Albion/Kanaka.

43.old: Maple Ridge is in School District 42 (SD42). Names, grades and addresses from the Province’s Maple Ridge school list and SD42. Checked against the official pages on October 17, 2026.
43.new: Maple Ridge schools belong to School District 42 (SD42). School names, grades and addresses come from SD42 and the Province’s list of Maple Ridge schools; they were compared with the official pages on October 17, 2026.

60.old: From City of Maple Ridge, Metro Vancouver and Fraser Valley Regional Library pages. Ask me what is closest to a specific home.
60.new: These details come from Fraser Valley Regional Library, Metro Vancouver and Maple Ridge City pages. Ask me about what is nearest a given home.

80.old: Canyon Trail runs from the fish hatchery to Cliff Falls, 1.2 km one way with some challenging hills. The flat Riverfront Trails are 3 km one way
80.new: Canyon Trail goes from the fish hatchery up to Cliff Falls, 1.2 km each way, and has some hard hills. The Riverfront Trails are flat and run 3 km each way.

101.old: Lot size (MLS sales data, not an official source): the median lot size of detached houses sold between July 1 and October 8, 2026 was 3,961 sq ft, based on 16 sales with a recorded lot size.
101.new: Between July 1 and October 8, 2026, the median lot size for detached houses sold was 3,961 sq ft. This comes from MLS sales data, not an official source, and covers 16 sales with a recorded lot size.

123.old: The City says it adopted updates to the Official Community Plan and to the Town Centre, Hammond, Silver Valley and Albion area plans in 2025. Albion’s was adopted on October 28 and the others in November.
123.new: In 2025 the City adopted updates to its Official Community Plan and to the area plans for Town Centre, Hammond, Silver Valley and Albion, according to the City. The Albion update was adopted on October 28, and the rest were adopted in November.

127.old: The City mails its Be Flood Ready guide to properties near the Fraser River floodplain. The guide includes a map of the Fraser River floodplain and an overview of the City’s flood response plan.
127.new: Properties close to the Fraser River floodplain get the City’s Be Flood Ready guide in the mail. Inside is a floodplain map for the Fraser River along with a summary of how the City would respond to a flood.

128.old: The City says it manages flood risk case by case, and that a proposed Floodplain Management Bylaw would set clearer rules, including minimum building elevations.
128.new: According to the City, flood risk is handled case by case. A Floodplain Management Bylaw has been proposed, and it would bring clearer rules such as minimum building elevations.

131.old: TransLink’s Langley–Haney Place Bus Rapid Transit line would run 22 km with 13 stations and service every 10 minutes at peak. TransLink says it is in detailed planning with preliminary funding through the 2025 Investment Plan, and that more funding is needed to deliver it.
131.new: The proposed Langley–Haney Place Bus Rapid Transit line from TransLink would cover 22 km, with 13 stations and a bus every 10 minutes at peak. TransLink describes it as being in detailed planning, with preliminary funding from the 2025 Investment Plan and more funding still needed to build it.

139.old: Ask the City what the Albion plan designations allow on the lots around the home, because new buildings can change a street.
139.new: Because new buildings can change a street, find out from the City which uses the Albion plan designations permit on the lots around the home.

170.old: The Maple Ridge Public Library is at 130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road, and it is the only Fraser Valley Regional Library branch in Maple Ridge.
170.new: At 130 – 22470 Dewdney Trunk Road you will find the Maple Ridge Public Library, the lone branch of the Fraser Valley Regional Library in Maple Ridge.

178.old: Lot size (MLS sales data, not an official source): the median lot size of detached houses sold between July 1 and October 8, 2026 was 3,961 sq ft, based on 16 sales with a recorded lot size.
178.new: Median lot size, from MLS sales data and not an official source: detached houses sold from July 1 to October 8, 2026 came out at 3,961 sq ft, using 16 sales that recorded a lot size.
